paite: Huai laitak in Jesu kiang ah hungzuite ahong pai ua, “Van lalgam ah kua athupipen dia?" achi uhi.
heading: Kingaihniamna Hamphatna / (Mar 9.33-37; Luk 9,46-48)
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

paite: Huan ama'n naupang neuchik asam a; alak uah adingsak hi.
english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon chi ahi, na lamdan ua, naupang neuchik bang na hong hih kei uleh, van-gam ah na lut kei hial ding uh.
english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: Huchi in kuapeuh hiai naupang neuchik bang a kingainiam, huai mi van-gam ah athupipen ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: Huan kuapeuh ka min ziak a hichibang naupang neuchik khat kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi.
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

paite: "Himahleh hiai hon gingta neuchikte lak a khat leng hihpuk, angawng ah buh gawizanna suang lianpi oksak in tuipi thuk lai ah khemang le uh, amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
heading: Midangte Hihpuk Mulkimhuai / (Mar 9.42-48; Luk 17.1-2)
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

paite: Puknate ziak in khovel tung agik hi, puknate bel om ding him ahi a; himahleh pukna omsakpa tung agik hi!
english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

paite: "Huan na khut hiam na khe hiam in hon hihpukleh, tankhia inla, paimang in; khut nih leh khe nih nei a tangtawn mei a paih a na om sang in, piangsual hiam khebai hiam a hinna a lut nang ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

paite: Huan na mit in hon hihpukleh khelkhia inla, paimang in; mit langnih nei a Gehenna mei a paih a om sang in, mit langkhat nei a hinna a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

paite: "Hiai mineute lak a khat leng simmoh lou ding in pilvang un, a-angelte un van ah ka Pa van a om mel a-en gige uh chih ka hon hilh ahi.
heading: Belam Mang Gentehna / (Luk 15.3-7)
english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Mihing Tapa mangthangte zong ding a hong pai ahi him hi.
english: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

paite: "Bangchi na sa ua? Mi kuapeuh in belam za nei henla, alak ua khat vakmang taleh sawmkua-le-kuate nusia in, tang a pai in, amang pen azong kei dia hia?
english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amuh nawn zenzenleh sawmkua-le-kua vakmangloute tung ah sang in, tua belam tung ah akipak zaw ding hi.
english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

paite: Huchi mah bang in hiai mineute lak a khat manthat na Pa uh van a om deihlam ahi kei hi.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

paite: "Huan na unau in na tung a thil ahihkhelhleh pai inla, amah leh nang kia theih in akhelhna hilh in; ahon ngaihkhiakleh na unau zou na hi ding.
heading: Unau Thil Hihkhial Thuhilhna
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

paite: Ahon ngaihkhiak keileh midang khat hiam nih hiam na kiang ah na pi dia, huchi in thu chiteng theihpihmi nih hiam thum hiam kam a hihkip a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

paite: Huan amau leng angaihkhiak nop kei laileh, saptuamte kiang ah tun in. Huan saptuamte leng angaihkhiak nop keileh amah tuh nang ding in Zentel leh siahkhonmi bang hi hen.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, leitung ah bangpeuh na hen uh, van ah hen ahi ding. Huan leitung a na phel uh, van ah leng phel ahi ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh nawn hi. Leitung ah na lak ua mi nih athilnget ua akithutuah uleh, ka Pa van a om hihsak in a-om ding uh.
heading: Tup Kibang A Thumna Gah
english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Mi nih hiam thum hiam ka min a akikhopna peuh uah alak uah ka om zel hi," achi hi.
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

paite: Huai lai in Peter ahong pai a, "Toupa, ka unau in bangzah vei ahia ka tung ah hihkhialleh ka ngaihdam ding? Sagihvei tan in ahi diam?" achi hi.
heading: Ngaihdamdan Ding
english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sagihvei tan ka hon chi kei a, sagihvei mun sawmsagih tan," ka hon chi zaw ahi.
english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

paite: "Huaiziak in van-gam tuh kuahiam asikhate kiang a asum thu saifel tum toh tehpih ahi.
heading: Ngaidam Nuam Lou Sikha Gentehna
english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

paite: Huchi a sum thu hon sai pattak in, mi khat talent singkhat ba akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

paite: Huan piak ding aneih louh ziak in, apu in amah toh, azi toh, atate toh, aneih tengteng toh zuak a dit ding thu apia hi.
english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

paite: Huchi in sikha in Toupa, 'ka tung ah zahngai tadih inla, avek in ka hon pe ding, chi in bokkhup in abia hi.'
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

paite: Huai sikhapa pu'n ahehpih mahmah a, akhah a, abat angaidamta hi.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

paite: "Himahleh huai sikha apaikhia a, asikha hihpihte lak a khat amakhai zakhat ba ava mu a; amah aman a, na bat hon pia in, chi in agawlmek hi.
english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

paite: Huchi in asikha hihpihpa'n bokkhup in, ka tung ah zahngai tadih inla, ka hon pe ding, chi in angen ngutngut hi.
english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

paite: Himahleh a-ut kei a; abat apiak zoh masiah suangkul ah akhumta hi.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

paite: Huchi in asikha hihpihte'n athilhih amuh un, poi asa mahmah ua, athilhih tengteng atoupa uh ahilhta uhi.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

paite: Huaitak in atoupa'n amah asam a, akiang ah, sikha gilou, na hon nget ngutngut ziak a, na bat tengteng hon ngaidam ing a;
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

paite: k'on hehpih bang in nang leng na sikha hihpih na hehpih sam ding hilou hia? achi hi.
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

paite: Huchi in atoupa athangpaita a, abat tengteng apiak zoh masiah migawtte kiang ah apeta hi.
english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

paite: Michih in na lungtangtak ua na unaute uh na ngaihdam kei uleh ka Pa van a om in leng huchi mah bang in na tung uah ahih sam ding," achi hi.
english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
